answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The timber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the crystal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
